scope: Exact guide/download execution, PDF page sizes, text/media filtering, embedded fonts, glyph coverage and repeated output. Visual review is separate. No printer, PDF/X or general CSS conformance claim.

observations: Both paper variants contain one complete card with readable title, product copy, price and scale footer.
The cup remains vector artwork in the PDF; both native and PDFium previews show its full shape.
The edition and price detail align to the right after explicit block display on their grid items.
No visible overlaps, clipped text or missing glyphs in the two tested layouts.
The screen-only instruction is absent; the small scale footer is present.
Native and PDFium text rasterization differs; no pixel-parity claim is made.
